title: Walking Aid Component

changes.text: Pole objects like mops, brooms, staves, scythes, and spears can now be held in a hand to act as walking aids, mitigating limping from fractures and reducing missing-leg slowdowns.
Walking aids must be held in the hand on the same side as the injured or missing leg to provide support, and lose their effectiveness if actively wielded with two hands.
Objects with the walking aid reduce limbless slowdown by 40%, while dedicated medical crutches reduce it by 60%.

changes.text: Added support for Radio TTS. You will now hear players over the radio via the TTS system.
Configure this in Game Options under the Sound tab.
Re-did blips to be significantly nicer sounding and way better.
Alien speech you don't understand now comes through as Blips. If you have TTS entirely disabled, you won't hear blips.
The Tram and Computers now utilize the TTS system. Configs have been added to set a consistent voice.
TTS audio now utilizes 3D audio; you can now walk away from people saying stupid shit and it gets quieter.
Blips also now include more customization options, and a dedicated Blips preview button by clicking the leaf icon.
The configuration to disable TTS on whispering has been removed, as it is no longer needed and also interferes with radio TTS functioning properly.
